justification: The provided evidence demonstrates operational robustness by showing the system's behavior across multiple non-standard conditions. Specifically, the system maintains high performance when subjected to variations and perturbations (randomly removed non-critical fields, OCR degradation, formatting variations, and predefined perturbation tests) and has an active out-of-distribution detection mechanism that successfully flagged 1,127 out of 1,200 out-of-distribution samples. Furthermore, these tests were independently reproduced by a separate validation team.
evidence_used: With 10% randomly removed non-critical fields, accuracy was 93.7%.
With the predefined OCR degradation transformation, accuracy was 92.1%.
Across the predefined formatting-variation set, accuracy ranged from 91.6% to 94.8%.
Of the 1,200 out-of-distribution samples, 1,127 were flagged by the out-of-distribution mechanism.
The validation protocol contains three predefined perturbation tests; corresponding accuracies were 92.8%, 90.9%, and 93.4%.
A separate validation team reproduced the reported tests.
limitations: The exact operational threshold for acceptable accuracy under degradation or perturbation is not specified.
It is not specified what action is taken for the remaining 73 out-of-distribution samples that were not flagged.
